subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should channels without native grouping metadata, starting with LINE, get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel contract, or no heuristic batching support?
rationale: LINE lacks a reliable album id, so automation should not choose the default latency, batching key, flush behavior, or plugin-vs-core ownership for a public config change.

options.title: LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared channel contract first
options.body: Design a media-aware channel SDK/core contract before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram album buffering only and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin config key and batch only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is primarily about shared inbound semantics and public config/product policy rather than a mechanical LINE-only bug fix.
